result:
I'd make every human being genuinely, viscerally uncomfortable with not knowing how things actually work.

Not "curious" in the polite, TED Talk sense. I mean a deep, almost physical itch that only real understanding relieves. The kind that makes people hate being lied to, including by themselves, more than they hate being wrong or unpopular.

Most of the world's worst problems aren't caused by malice. They're caused by layers of convenient delusions stacked on top of each other. If that baseline discomfort with ignorance became universal, a lot of the rest would start unraveling on its own.
